children: A fire broke out Saturday at a Quaker Oats plant in Cedar Rapids after a suspected explosion. According to Sina Finance, the Cedar Rapids Fire Department said it received the alarm at about 4:45 p.m. and that an explosion triggered the blaze. Mayor Tiffany O’Donnell said all employees were evacuated and accounted for, with no injuries; the fire started in the plant’s product-handling area, and its cause remains unknown. PepsiCo’s U.S. foods division said emergency responders were at the scene and the cause would be investigated. Quaker Oats says the facility is the world’s largest oat-processing plant, capable of processing more than 2 million pounds of oats per day. The brand is owned by PepsiCo and will mark its 150th anniversary in 2027.

title: Suspected Explosion Sparks Fire at Quaker Oats’ Largest Oat-Processing Plant
